summary: Iteration 4 — Earnings Distribution system. Backend 30/30 pytest cases pass (10 new earnings tests + 7 edit/reports updated to 18-field shape + 6 photo updated to 18 + 7 base repair-shop). POST /api/jobs returns technician_share/boss_share computed correctly: (cost=1200,amount=3000,pct=30) → profit=1800, tech=540, boss=1260; (pct=40) → tech=720, boss=1080; zero-profit and negative-profit cases also correct. GET /api/jobs returns exactly 18 keys per job (original 15 + Photo + technician_share + boss_share). Legacy MongoDB row with only Share field is correctly derived by normalize_job (tech=Share, boss=Profit-Share). POST /api/jobs/update with cost|amount|percentage change recomputes Profit + Share + technician_share + boss_share and lists all keys in updated[]; status-only update still works (regression) without touching earnings. Frontend (mobile 390x844, Local mode): Top KPIs render kpi-pending, kpi-completed, kpi-profit (green), kpi-boss (blue ₹12,740), kpi-tech (orange ₹5,460), all driven by Completed jobs only. JobCard shows Amount/Cost/Profit row + split Technician/Boss row with exact color tokens — computed colors confirmed: profit rgb(34,197,94)=#22c55e, tech rgb(251,146,60)=#fb923c, boss rgb(96,165,250)=#60a5fa. Reports view: section-business (Revenue/Cost/Profit/Status), section-boss (Total Boss Share, big-kpi blue), section-technician (Total Technician Share, big-kpi orange), section-completed (Revenue/Profit/Boss/Tech completed-only). Period chips period-today/week/month/all filter correctly. Data consistency verified across API & UI: 51 jobs → Revenue ₹1,28,200 - Cost ₹51,000 = Profit ₹77,200 = Boss ₹52,240 + Tech ₹24,960; completed-only (9 jobs) → Revenue ₹28,000, Profit ₹18,200 = Boss ₹12,740 + Tech ₹5,460. Edit pencil regression still opens dialog.

issues: 'Made with Emergent' badge (bottom-right) overlaps the FAB and sometimes intercepts click events — pre-existing from iteration 2/3. Test agent had to bypass with existing-card flow for edit regression. Consider lifting FAB z-index or adding bottom padding-bottom > 80px to the job list.

'Today' label shows 'Scope: jobs from YYYY-MM-DD onwards' which is technically correct (>= fromISO) but semantically inclusive of future dates; with IST stamps this is fine today but slightly misleading phrasing.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py normalize_job(): backward-compat derives boss_share from (Profit - tech_val). If a legacy row had negative Profit and Share=0, this silently yields negative boss (acceptable per earnings rule) — good. However if only boss_share is present but not technician_share, code picks tech_val=share (fallback 0) and boss=existing boss; these two may not sum to Profit. Very unlikely given producers, but consider validating tech+boss == profit and reconciling.
server.py update_job() numeric_changed branch: still rewrites Cost/Amount/Percentage every time any numeric field changes — writes unchanged columns to Sheet unnecessarily (carry-over from iter-3).

server.py add_job(): new_pct fallback 'percentage or 30' converts 0.0 to 30 because 0.0 is falsy. If a shop ever wants a 0% technician split (boss keeps 100%), this silently changes it to 30%. Same pattern repeats in update_job. Consider `percentage if percentage is not None else 30` explicit None-check.

RepairShop.jsx totals: Boss/Tech KPIs sum over Completed jobs only — matches spec. But Profit (done) also sums only Completed, identical logic repeated — consider extracting single completed-aggregator.

Reports.jsx Business Summary 'all' uses filter-by-received_date while Completed section uses filter-by-completed_date. Good, but the 'Jobs/Pending' counts within Business card mix both received and completed sets (pending = all.count - completedInReceivedPeriod). If a job was received last month but completed today, it will still be counted 'pending' under 'today' scope — edge case worth documenting.
JobCard.jsx: split-row Technician label shows `${job.Percentage || 30}%` — if a job legitimately has percentage=0 this falls back to 30%. Display-only bug; mirrors the backend issue above.
google_apps_script.gs was referenced but not inspected — Sheet not connected in this env, so backward-compat column migration logic (17,18) cannot be verified end-to-end here.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_Earn/TEST_Edit-prefixed jobs via pytest (4 add + 3 update + 1 status-only + 1 legacy LEGACY01). LEGACY01 is cleaned up by the test. Other TEST_* remain in MongoDB for UI visual inspection.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Earnings distribution contract: normalize_job always returns 18 keys. technician_share == Share (legacy alias); boss_share == Profit - technician_share. Backward compat: rows without tech/boss get them derived from Share. Update recomputes both when any of cost/amount/percentage is patched; status-only updates leave earnings untouched. Frontend color tokens verified: --profit #22c55e, --tech #fb923c, --boss #60a5fa. Known bug: 0% percentage silently becomes 30 due to truthy check (`percentage or 30`). Known UX: 'Made with Emergent' badge overlaps FAB on 390x844 (pre-existing).
rca of the issue: No defects found in earnings distribution feature. All backend math correct, all frontend testids present, colors match spec, backward compat works. Minor code-hygiene suggestions listed above for main agent consideration only.
